intro:

This fast-paced browser game drops you into a world where you must avoid being caught by those who want your hard-earned cash. The objective is simple: tap the screen to jump over rolling barrels and make your way through the streets without getting caught. But don't be fooled - this game is more challenging than it seems. With its addictive gameplay, simple yet intuitive controls, and visually stunning graphics, Tax Escape is sure to keep you on the edge of your seat.

With each level, the difficulty ramps up, and you'll find yourself wondering how you'll ever make it out alive. But that's what makes it so addictive - you'll be hooked from the very first level.

Tax Escape is a game that will appeal to anyone who loves a good challenge. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for something to pass the time, this game has something for everyone. So why not give it a try? With its simple yet addictive gameplay, stunning visuals, and exciting atmosphere, Tax Escape is sure to become your new favorite game.

So what are you waiting for? Jump into the world of Tax Escape and start your journey today!
